profile.name: 被动监测实验界面与通信组件
profile.name_en: Passive Monitoring GUI and Communication Component
profile.description: 这是一个非物理软件组件，用于被动监测实验中的仪器通信与图形界面控制。它负责连接并协调 Keithley 2400 与 Lake Shore 仪器，执行实验配置、读取测量数据、记录日志，以及管理界面状态与实验流程。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for instrument communication and GUI control in passive monitoring experiments. It connects and coordinates a Keithley 2400 and a Lake Shore instrument, handling experiment configuration, measurement retrieval, logging, and UI workflow management.

registry.name: RT Measurement (Passive)
registry.description: RT Measurement Backend (Passive)是一款表征设备，主要功能包括停止、参数配置、启动、扫描、日志记录、测量。支持Signal, Slot, create widgets等操作。
